items.t: Argus’s $150 Target Says Reddit’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.sum: Key TakeawaysArgus cut its Reddit price target to $150 from $225 and kept its Buy rating, a target 49% above today’s price. Reddit’s stock has sunk since its third-quarter report, when management warned that search traffic from Alphabet’s Google is falling fast and daily users could drop.

items.t: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman on surfing today's internet with AI
items.sum: Reddit (RDDT) CEO and co-founder Steve Huffman joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss how AI depends on human-generated content like Reddit's and is one of the last platforms requiring users to log in.

items.t: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman explains the 'paradox' of AI for his company
items.sum: While AI may be the future, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman sees his company as powered by humans.

items.t: Reddit Sinks 6% as Traffic Falls 13% on Google’s AI Overviews: “Not Traffic Drivers”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 6% after Similarweb data showed a 13% drop in global visits, which Business Insider blamed on Google’s AI Overviews. Most of the lost visits were logged out, and the logged-in users behind over 80% of its monetization are still growing.
